“**大笑奶龙**” is a Chinese reaction meme featuring 奶龙 (Nailong), the round yellow dinosaur from the Chinese animated shorts of the same name. The character comes from 深圳市第七印象文化传媒有限公司, which began releasing Nailong shorts in 2020. That dates the character. I don’t know which clip or post first circulated as “大笑奶龙,” or who first called it “奶蛙.”

The recognizable feature is the face. Nailong normally has a plump body, tiny limbs and a rounded snout. In the laughing image, its eyes narrow and its mouth opens into an exaggerated grin. The face looks broad and frog-like, which is the visual joke in **“奶蛙”** (“Nai-frog”), a pun that swaps 龙 (“dragon”) for 蛙 (“frog”).

As a reaction image or looping GIF, the grin can read as delighted laughter or as laughing *at* somebody. Cropping in on the face, freezing the grin, or looping and dubbing the laugh can make the same expression look increasingly absurd. A related Nailong joke is **“我是奶龙”** (“I’m Nailong”), with the comeback **“我才是奶龙”** (“*I’m* the real Nailong”). That exchange gets quoted and redubbed in its own right.
